D4 | branch condition impossible given assignments above | In `_human_bytes`, the loop condition `n < 1024 or unit == "TiB"` will always be true for the last iteration because unit becomes "TiB" and the condition is true, so the loop always breaks at TiB. But the division `n /= 1024.0` happens before the check? Actually the check is at the top of the loop: `for unit in ...: if n < 1024 or unit == "TiB": return ...; n /= 1024.0`. For the first units (B, KiB, MiB, GiB), if n >= 1024, the condition is false, so n is divided and loop continues. For TiB, the condition is always true because unit == "TiB". So the loop always returns at TiB. But there is a logic error: for unit="B", the condition `n < 1024` is checked, and if n is large, it goes to the next unit. But the return statement for B uses `f"{n:.0f} {unit}"` which is correct. For subsequent units, the return statement uses `f"{n / 1:.1f} {unit}"` which is a no-op division; it should be `f"{n:.1f} {unit}"`. This is a bug but not D4. No D4.
